<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">November 19, 2026</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:center;margin:0pt;"><b>AMES NATIONAL CORPORATION DECLARED CASH DIVIDEND</b></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">AMES, IOWA &#8211; Ames National Corporation (the &#8220;Company&#8221;) announced today that a stock repurchase program was approved at a meeting of the Board of Directors held November 18, 2026. The program authorizes the repurchase of up to 200,000 shares, or approximately 2.3% of 8,857,220 shares of common stock outstanding as of November 18, 2026. This program will commence on November 19, 2026 and expire on November 9, 2027. The repurchases will be made in open market transactions at the discretion of management using Company cash. The timing and actual number of shares purchased will depend on a variety of factors such as price, the Company&#8217;s liquidity position and other market conditions. The program will be conducted under the provisions of SEC Rule 10b-18 which provides a &#8220;safe harbor&#8221; from liability for manipulation of the stock price by reason of the manner, timing, price and volume of purchases in the open market. The program may be limited or discontinued at any time without notice. The Company purchased 34,947 shares under its previously authorized stock repurchase program that expired on November 17, 2026.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">On November 18, 2026, Ames National Corporation declared a cash dividend of $0.24 per common share. The dividend is payable December 15, 2026, to shareholders of record at the close of business on December 1, 2026.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">Ames National Corporation is listed on the NASDAQ Capital Market under the ticker symbol, ATLO. The Company&#8217;s affiliate banks include: First National Bank, Ames, Iowa; Boone Bank &amp; Trust Co., Boone, Iowa; State Bank &amp; Trust Co., Nevada, Iowa; Iowa State Savings Bank, Creston, Iowa; Reliance State Bank, Story City, Iowa; and United Bank &amp; Trust Co., Marshalltown, Iowa. Additional information about the Company can be found at <u>www.amesnational.com</u>.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>
